ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (56) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

Tolstoy's retelling sets Hugo's scene in Russia, and its Russian details are kept: «городовой» (gorodovoy, 'policeman'), «царей» (tsarey, 'tsars'), «попов» (popov, 'priests'), the boy's «батя» (batya, a folk word for 'father', here 'Dad'). The crowd's «мерзавец» (merzavets, 'scoundrel') and «негодяй» (negodyay, 'villain') are kept distinct, and «безжалостный» (bezzhalostny, 'pitiless') is repeated as in the source.
Source observation: [33] «— Без тебя не пойду. — сказал мальчик»: a period stands before the speech dash where a comma is expected; translated as a normal speech tag.
